Graphics atlas of Barbarian: The Blood Path

Generated by tools/atlas/gen_atlas.py from the files the C64 reads (out/work/gfx/gfx0.prg, gfx1, gfx2, charset.bin, uifont.bin, out/work/title.koa) and from the palettes of src/game.asm. Two parts (11/11): common graphics, valid for every chapter (charset, HUD, UI font, sprites, menus, title, story), and one part per chapter (data/chapters.yaml: village, dungeon themes, final map; chapters). Tile id = 5 letters of the set + the legend letter (village: data/town_map.txt; dungeon and throne: DUN_LEGEND in tools/build/gen_gfx.py). Data: tiles.json, PNGs in png/. Hover a tile: id, letter and the tile magnified pixel by pixel (the C64 multicolour pixel is twice as wide: 2:1 rectangles, 1 px grid). Copyright © 2026 - Simone Caporale
